title: Being a good friend
examples: What should I do if my friend is upset?
How do I show someone I care?
Is it always okay to share my toys?

explain.say: Today we learn about being a good friend. Kindness means being nice to others always.
Sharing means letting others use your things too. You can share your crayons with a friend.

draw.text: Sharing: Letting others use your things.

explain.say: If you make a mistake, you must say sorry. Saying sorry helps make things better.
A good friend listens when you talk to them. Listening shows you care a lot.
When you are playing, remember to take turns with toys. This is being a good friend.
If a friend is sad, you can give them a gentle hug. You can also ask if they want to play.

faq.q: What if I do not want to share my favorite toy?
faq.a: It is okay to feel that way first. You can say, 'Can I play with it for five more minutes?'
asks: How do I ask to use something?

faq.q: What if my friend does not say sorry?
faq.a: You can tell a grown-up who is nearby. They can help you talk about it.
asks: Who do I tell if it is hard?
Can I make them say sorry?

faq.q: Is being kind only for big kids?
faq.a: No, being kind is for everyone, all the time. Little actions make big differences.
asks: Do I have to be perfect?

faq.q: What is the best way to show kindness?
faq.a: The best way is to notice when someone needs a smile or a helping hand. Small acts count the most.
asks: What is the kindest thing to do?
How often should I be kind?

faq.q: If I say sorry, do I have to do anything else?
faq.a: It is good to say sorry and then try to fix it with your actions. Actions show you mean it.

facts: Kindness means treating others with care and warmth.
Sharing means taking turns with toys or snacks.
When you make a mistake, saying sorry is important.
Good friends listen when others are speaking.

quiz.say: If your friend drops their books, what is a kind thing to do?
quiz.why: This shows kindness by helping someone who needs it.

wrong.0: Walking away shows you do not care about them.
wrong.1: Pointing and giggling is not kind at all.
wrong.3: Laughing makes the friend feel worse, not better.

quiz.say: You take a crayon, and your friend wants it. What should you do?
quiz.why: Taking turns is a way of sharing nicely.

wrong.0: Keeping it all makes your friend feel sad.
wrong.1: Throwing things is not safe or kind.
wrong.2: Silence can make the friend think you do not care.

quiz.say: You accidentally bump your friend and they fall down. What should you say?
quiz.why: Saying sorry fixes the feeling when you make a mistake.

wrong.0: Standing still does not fix the mistake you made.
wrong.2: This sounds like blaming them for falling.
wrong.3: Running away makes them feel like you do not care.
